description: Creates a WorkQ item with the Practice setup form attached. Run it once for the pilot practice, and again any time a second practice needs onboarding.

flowIr.description: Creates a WorkQ item with the Practice setup form attached. Run it once for the pilot practice, and again any time a second practice needs onboarding.
flowIr.name: Healthcare Practice Management: Start practice setup

nodes.code:
actor = params.get("actor") or ""
assignees = [actor] if actor else None

item = api.workq.create(
    title="Set up a practice for Healthcare Practice Management",
    scope="org",
    description=(
        "Fill in the **Practice setup** form attached to this item: the practice name, its Cliniko "
        "business ID, which email platform it uses, its Xero organisation (if any), timezone, "
        "cancellation window and who reviews drafts.\n\n"
        "The Practice Manager Agent can't read or act for a practice until this is saved."
    ),
    priority="high",
    assignee_ids=assignees,
    labels=["healthcare-practice-management", "setup"],
)
api.workq.attach_form(todo_id=item["id"], form_id=params["setup_form"])
created_id = item["id"]

outputs.description: The id of the WorkQ item created for this setup run.
outputs.name: created_id
